_doc: Example publish-config.json. Copy to ~/.claude/publish-config.json and customise. See https://github.com/YOURNAME/REPONAME/blob/main/skills/publish-to-github/SKILL.md for details. Keys starting with underscore are documentation hints — the script ignores them. JSON arrays cannot have inline comments, so docs live in adjacent _* keys.

source._doc: Where to copy from. Defaults: root='~/.claude', subdirs=['skills', 'agents'].

_exclusions_doc: Directory paths (relative to source.root) to exclude entirely from the staging copy. Use this for skills you never want to publish.
_scrubs_doc: Find/replace rules per file. Each scrub targets one file (relative to source.root) and lists the find/replace pairs to apply. Ordering: longest find string is applied first to prevent shorter prefixes from corrupting longer matches.
_forbidden_patterns_doc: Strings the verifier greps for AFTER scrubbing. Any match in the staging dir = a leak the scrubs missed. Treat as a final safety net.
_bundle_files_doc: External files (README, docs, etc.) to copy into the staging dir alongside skills/ and agents/. source can be a file or a directory. Directory sources skip hidden (.*) and underscore-prefixed (_*) files — use a per-file bundle entry for individual hidden files. Sources that resolve outside ~/ trigger a warning (footgun check).
_extended_scan_ignore_doc: Suppress known false positives from --extended-scan. Each entry: { 'file' OR 'file_pattern' (fnmatch glob, relative to staging root), 'categories' (list of category names from EXTENDED_SCAN_PATTERNS in publish_prep.py, or the string '*' for all). Common false positives: skills that document credential-shaped example strings, networking skills with public DNS IPs (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8), .local TLDs in mDNS docs. Available categories: anthropic-api-key, openai-api-key, stripe-live, github-pat-classic, github-pat-fine, slack-bot, slack-user, google-api-key, aws-access-key, rsa-private-key, openssh-private, ec-private-key, pgp-private-key, jwt-token, bearer-literal, aws-secret, db-conn-string, gcp-service-account, real-email, internal-tld, public-ipv4, phone-e164, large-file, dangling-symlink.
_gitignore_doc: Set to a custom .gitignore string, or omit/null for the default. Config exclusions are auto-appended to whatever gitignore is generated.
